summary: Batch #32 — Trusted Helpers PHASE 3 (Care Team group chat + Live Pickup GPS + Medical Sharing + Helper Ratings). BACKEND: 26/26 pytest pass in ~11s (new file /app/backend/tests/test_batch32_trusted_helpers_phase3.py). Covered: (1) CARE-TEAM ISOLATION — parent posting into Family Chat (db.messages) NEVER surfaces in /care-team/chat or /helper/care-team; a message posted into the 1:1 helper chat (db.helper_messages) also NEVER surfaces in either care-team endpoint. Backing collection is db.care_team_messages only. (2) NO-CHAT-PERMISSION helper (permissions.chat=false) → 403 on GET+POST /helper/care-team. (3) CROSS-TOKEN BOUNDARY (parametrised) — parent token: 401 on /helper/care-team, /helper/medical, /helper/dashboard; helper token: 401 on /care-team/chat, /care-team/unread, /helpers/{id}/ratings, /helpers, /families/me, /home. (4) CARE-TEAM ROUND-TRIP — parent POST → helper GET sees it and helper GET returns me=helper_id, my_type='helper'; helper POST → parent GET sees it and parent view returns my_type='parent' with a non-empty roster of active helpers (Sunita present). /care-team/unread returns 0 after parent read, ≥1 after a fresh helper post, back to 0 after re-read. (5) LIVE PICKUP LOCATION — POST /helper/tasks/{id}/location correctly 400s BEFORE 'Start Trip' (detail says 'Start the trip …'); after POST /helper/tasks/{id}/trip stage=en_route the same location call 200s, and coords (lat/lng/loc_updated_at) appear in that task's completion.trip and are visible to the parent via /api/helpers/{id}/activity. (6) MEDICAL SHARING — permission gate: helper WITHOUT medical perm → 403. Demo helper (Sunita, medical perm + Aarav assigned) sees exactly one card for Aarav with blood_group='O+', allergies='Peanuts, dust', doctor='Dr. Mehta (Rainbow Clinic)', hospital='Apollo Hospital, Sarita Vihar', emergency_contact='Priya (Mom) +91 98100 12345'. CRITICAL PRIVACY: response has ONLY the 6 whitelisted keys {member, blood_group, allergies, doctor, hospital, emergency_contact} — assertion iterates every card and forbids 'medication', 'conditions', 'insurance', 'policy' substrings anywhere in the serialised card. Scoping: a SECOND helper (medical perm) assigned to a different member does NOT see Aarav's card and DOES see the assigned member. (7) HELPER RATINGS — invalid rating 'banana' → 400 (or 422 pydantic); 'up' rating flips /helper/dashboard.rated_up_today=true; GET /helpers/{id}/ratings returns {ratings: [...], up, total, today} with today.rating='up' and today.note preserved; same-day upsert overwrites (up→down flips today.rating and rated_up_today=false). Restored back to 'up' for the UI test. (8) LIFECYCLE — after pause and after remove: /helper/care-team, /helper/medical, /helper/dashboard, /helper/tasks/{id}/location all blocked (401/403). FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844): (A) Helper portal login (sunita/1234) — all 5 Phase-3 testIDs visible: portal-praise (banner 'The family appreciated your work today. Thank you!'), portal-chat-btn (unread=2), portal-careteam-btn, portal-handover-btn, portal-medical-btn. (B) Care Team screen: careteam-input + careteam-send work; UI-driven 'TEST_UI_CT_HELP_XYZ789' appears in DOM after send; previous backend markers TEST_CT_P2H_*, TEST_CT_H2P_*, TEST_CT_UNREAD_* all visible in the same thread → confirmed bidirectional; isolation banner 'Shared with parents and your active helpers. The family chat can't see this.' rendered. (C) Medical screen (portal-medical-btn → /helper-portal/medical): medcard-<aarav_id> present (count=1) with 'Allergies: Peanuts, dust', 'Doctor: Dr. Mehta (Rainbow Clinic)', 'Hospital: Apollo Hospital, Sarita Vihar', 'Emergency contact: Priya (Mom) +91 98100 12345', and O+ badge in header. No 'medication', 'insurance', 'policy', or 'conditions' text anywhere on the screen (privacy scrub verified). Emergency-only banner rendered. (D) Pickup task on portal after Start Trip: 'Share live location' section rendered with trip-live-* toggle (count=1) — as expected, web geolocation can't move so we only assert the toggle mounts without crashing. (E) Parent flow (storytester@fam.com): tap tab-family → scroll to Trusted Helpers section → helper-card-help_c77a0a30120545bb (Sunita) visible with Active badge, and care-team-cta (Care Team Chat card) visible with care-team-unread badge=1. Tap care-team-cta → parent Care Team thread opens (careteam-input present), UI-driven 'TEST_UI_CT_PARENT_ZZ8' appears after send; all pytest markers (TEST_CT_UNREAD_*, TEST_UI_CT_HELP_XYZ789 from helper) visible → parent↔helper round-trip visually confirmed. (F) Sunita helper detail: helper-chat-btn visible; scrolled to 'How was today?' — rate-up (👍 Great) / rate-down (👎 Needs work) / rate-note all render. Filled note 'TEST_UI_RATE_UI_NOTE_888', tapped rate-up → toast + 'Today logged: 👍 · TEST_UI_RATE_UI_NOTE_888' + a new rate-hist-<id> entry ('👍 2026-08-18 · TEST_UI_RATE_UI_NOTE_888') appear. Recent Activity shows 'Pick up Aarav from school — started 5 minutes ago' (from the pytest en_route call). NO deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) introduced by Phase 3 files. All buttons use Pressable; all text wrapped in Text/AppText. No React-Native red screens, no console errors beyond the pre-existing expo-notifications web-support warning. Verdict: Batch #32 (Phase 3) fully passes end-to-end. No new bugs, no react-native/expo issues.

critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY (server.py:6577/6592/6961/6971): Care Team endpoints use a DEDICATED db.care_team_messages collection with family_id filter — impossible to leak Family Chat (db.messages) or 1:1 helper chat (db.helper_messages). Verified by inserting markers into both other collections and asserting they never surface. Well-scoped.

SECURITY (server.py:6961/6971): both /helper/care-team GET and POST are gated with Depends(require_helper_permission('chat')) — a helper without chat perm gets 403. Same 'chat' permission the 1:1 helper chat uses. Consistent.

PRIVACY (server.py:6987-7009): /helper/medical whitelists exactly {blood_group, allergies, doctor, hospital, emergency_contact} + a minimal member envelope; medication_list / conditions / insurance_provider / policy_reference are never read from db.medical_cards. The endpoint also scopes to h.assigned_all OR h.assigned_member_ids only — cross-child leak impossible. Excellent defensive design.

server.py:6948-6958 (helper_task_location) uses update_one WITHOUT upsert=True and matched_count==0 → 400 'Start the trip before sharing your location'. This correctly requires a prior POST /helper/tasks/{id}/trip to have created today's completion row. Great UX gate.

server.py:6478-6486 (helper_activity): parent-side visibility of trip.lat/lng/loc_updated_at is via helper_task_completions with { $set: 'trip.lat|lng|loc_updated_at' } — verified end-to-end that the parent /helpers/{id}/activity returns coords.

server.py:6619-6633 (rate_helper): correct upsert per (helper_id, family_id, date) and rating whitelist ('up','down' → 400 otherwise). rating_id only $setOnInsert so same-day overwrite keeps the original id — clean history semantics.
server.py:6797-6798 (helper_dashboard.rated_up_today): computed by checking today's rating.rating == 'up' — flips true/false correctly on overwrite.

server.py:6577-6589 (parent_care_team) uses reader='m:{member_id}' and $addToSet on read_by — idempotent. /care-team/unread excludes the parent's own messages ('sender_id': {$ne: mine}) so parents never see their own messages as unread. Correct.
get_current_user rejects helper tokens and get_current_helper rejects family tokens — verified again in Phase 3 for the new endpoints via parametrised TestCrossTokenBoundary.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Phase-3 backend routes: parent GET/POST /api/care-team/chat + GET /api/care-team/unread + POST /api/helpers/{id}/rating + GET /api/helpers/{id}/ratings. Helper self: GET/POST /api/helper/care-team (needs 'chat' perm), GET /api/helper/medical (needs 'medical' perm), POST /api/helper/tasks/{task_id}/location (must Start Trip first). All in server.py around lines 6577-7009. 2) New collections: db.care_team_messages (fields: message_id, family_id, sender_type in {'parent','helper'}, sender_id, sender_name, sender_role, text/photo_url, read_by=[m:<mid> or h:<hid>], created_at) and db.helper_ratings (fields: rating_id, helper_id, family_id, date=YYYY-MM-DD, rating in {'up','down'}, note, by, by_name, created_at). Live pickup coords live on db.helper_task_completions.trip.{lat,lng,loc_updated_at}. 3) Frontend testIDs verified: portal-praise, portal-chat-btn, portal-careteam-btn, portal-handover-btn, portal-medical-btn (helper-portal/index.tsx); careteam-input, careteam-send, careteam-back, ctmsg-<id> (CareTeamChatView.tsx); medcard-<member_id>, medcall-<member_id>, medical-back (helper-portal/medical.tsx); trip-live-* (helper-portal/index.tsx — pickup task after Start Trip); care-team-cta, care-team-unread, helper-card-<id> (family.tsx); helper-chat-btn, rate-up, rate-down, rate-note, rate-hist-<id> (helper/[id].tsx). 4) Helper create payload shape (from batch#30 line 132): TOP-LEVEL name, role, assigned_all (bool), assigned_member_ids, permissions dict, username, pin. To test medical 403 → permissions={medical:false}. To test medical scoping → assigned_all:false + assigned_member_ids:[non_aarav_mid] + permissions:{medical:true}. 5) CRITICAL PRIVACY assertion: /helper/medical response must NEVER include the strings 'medication', 'conditions', 'insurance', 'policy' anywhere in a serialised card — the backend keeps only {member, blood_group, allergies, doctor, hospital, emergency_contact}. 6) Location endpoint returns 400 BEFORE the day's trip row exists (i.e. before Start Trip). Because pytest fires Start Trip and the demo pickup task is now 'On the way', a subsequent 400-before-trip test needs to first wipe today's completion for that task: db.helper_task_completions.delete_many({helper_id:'help_c77a0a30120545bb', date: today}). 7) /helper/care-team GET marks msgs as read on the helper side by $addToSet reader='h:<hid>'. /care-team/chat GET does the same for parent reader='m:<mid>'. /care-team/unread excludes the caller's own messages so the count is symmetric on both sides. 8) Auth boundary — get_current_user rejects helper tokens (401) and vice-versa for all Phase-3 routes. 9) Web preview cannot exercise real geolocation → for trip-live-* toggle test just confirm it renders after Start Trip and doesn't crash on prompt-denied. 10) Ratings today for Sunita end at 'up' with UI note (see seed_data_creation). Wipe the day's row before retesting the 'no rating today' state.
